title: RE-RAG: Improving Open-Domain QA Performance and Interpretability with Relevance Estimator in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
why_relevant: Proposes a relevance estimator that filters irrelevant retrieved contexts, enables abstention ('unanswerable'), and chooses between parametric and retrieved knowledge based on confidence—directly addressing noisy retrieval, calibration/control, and parametric-vs-retrieved conflict.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on open-domain QA performance; robustness analysis is a secondary contribution rather than a comprehensive study.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control / Filtering Noisy Retrieval
